newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico poultry farm population at 172 mln head.
newsitem.headline: Mexico poultry farm population at 172 mln head.

text.p: Mexico's poultry population in farms is estimated at 172 million head, specialist veterinarians Laboratorios Columbia said in a document obtained Wednesday.
It said 5 companies housed 32 percent of that population and another 10 firms had 28 percent, with the remaining 40 percent shared among an unspecified number of other farms.

Jalisco is the top producer state with 16.3 percent of the estimated head, followed by Queretaro with 8.7 percent and Guanajuato with 8.6 percent, Columbia said in in the Mexican Hog Farming Council's magazine.
It gave no breakdown of poultry types.
